detail.subject: Recap: FleetTrack 2.0 status call and next steps
detail.body:
Hi Megan,

Thank you for the candid conversation today. Here is a quick recap.

Dispatcher demo: The Samsara sandbox credentials arrived on November 6 instead of late October, so integration testing started late. The demo is now December 4.

February 15: This is still our plan. The buffer has gone from three weeks to one, and I will flag anything early.

Map freeze: We are adding clustering so the map loads only what is on screen, and we will load test it with 1,000 vehicles. The target is December 18.

Offline mode: This is outside current scope, so we will handle it through an impact analysis. Usman will send the estimate within three business days.

SOC 2: I will make sure Usman gets Jason what the security team needs.

Added developers: This option has an onboarding cost and would realistically buy about a week. I will include it in the revised plan.

Next steps:
- Sara: revised plan to you by Friday
- Usman: offline mode estimate within three business days

Best regards,
Sara Khan
Project Manager, FleetTrack 2.0

detail.moodForecast: Likely concerned but professional: the slip and a buffer cut to one week will raise worry. Expect firm, direct questions about risk and dates.

likelyQuestions.q: Why did Sprint 6 slip, and is it really recovered?
likelyQuestions.answer: Samsara sandbox credentials were requested 28 October and arrived 6 November, 9 days late, which delayed integration testing. The demo is now 4 December; I now flag dependencies a week earlier.

likelyQuestions.q: Is the 15 February go-live still safe?
likelyQuestions.answer: It is still achievable, but buffer has dropped from 3 weeks to 1 week. I will flag any risk to the date the same day I see it.

likelyQuestions.q: Can you add developers to win back time or add offline mode?
likelyQuestions.answer: Two extra developers need about 2 weeks onboarding, adding roughly 1 week of buffer from mid-January, and need a CR. Offline mode (CR-03) risks go-live; Usman will send impact analysis within 3 business days.

likelyQuestions.q: What are the open bugs and quality risks before UAT?
likelyQuestions.answer: 14 bugs open, 2 high priority. BUG-198 (Android photo upload) targets 4 December; BUG-211 (map freeze over 500 vehicles) is due 18 December. Crash-free is 99.1% versus 99.5% target.

likelyQuestions.q: Are we on budget, and are you SOC 2 certified?
likelyQuestions.answer: 58% of approved hours are used at 55% completion, within tolerance. I can't discuss certifications on this call; Usman will share documentation within 3 business days.

landmines: Don't promise new dates or recovered buffer beyond the approved plan.
Don't quote dollar figures or confirm/deny SOC 2 or contract terms.
Don't agree to offline mode or extra developers; route to Usman as a CR.
Don't imply the client caused the delay; state credential dates factually.
mustSay: Sprint 6 demo moved to 4 December; go-live 15 February still achievable.
Buffer is now 1 week; I'll flag risks same day.
HOS integration due 1 December; BUG-198 fix targeted 4 December.
Written status report goes out Friday; written confirmations within 24 hours.
questionsToAsk: What matters most to you about the 4 December demo?
Who from Harborline will attend the demo and give feedback?
Any Samsara or AWS dependencies from your side before UAT?
Does the 15 December pen test timing work for Jason?
